regions.merged_text: November 4th. Again many thanks for your generous favor of October 16th. May the dear Lord bless you for same. Thank you specially for enrolling me. Yours must make about a dozen perpetual enrollments I've had this Jubilee year, and I have no idea how often I've been enrolled annually. The continued favors we have reported as through this association gives me an appreciation for such enrollments that I could hardly have otherwise. Thanks be to God. .. As to taking children for adoption, I look at that according to our dear Lord's own appreciation: "What you have done for the least of my brethren You have done to me. " -- It is getting late now: So. I'll say Good Night for the present
